article: For each question, write the correct answer. A trip to the theatre We had a class day out today. We went on a theatre trip (27)…………… see Shakespeare's play Hamlet. A friend of mine, (28)…………… has always been really into Shakespeare, had already told me the story. Basically, Hamlet discovers a terrible secret about his family, but he can't decide (29)…………… to do about it. I won't say any more about the story, in case you decide to go and see it as well. I’d hate to spoil it for you! The only thing I didn't like about the play was (30)…………… it lasted for three hours. For me, that was far (31)…………… long, and the seats were quite uncomfortable.  Afterwards, my mum asked me (32)…………… I’d go and see another Shakespeare play. I said yes, I probably would, but I'd take a cushion next time!

explanations.27:
原因：不定式 “to see” 表目的，“去看莎士比亚的戏剧”。
语法点：不定式作目的状语，可替换为 in order to/so as to，如 “I study hard to get good grades.”
explanations.28:
原因：非限制性定语从句修饰 friend，关系代词 who 在从句中作主语，指人。
语法点：非限制性定语从句用 who/which 引导，不可用 that，如 “My father, who is a teacher, likes reading.”
explanations.29:
原因：宾语从句 “what to do”，what 作 do 的宾语，表 “做什么”。
语法点：特殊疑问词 + 不定式结构，如 “I don't know how to solve the problem.”
explanations.30:
原因：表语从句引导词 that，无实义，仅起连接作用。
语法点：that 引导表语从句时不可省略，如 “The fact is that he lied to me.”
explanations.31:
原因：“far too long” 表 “太长”，too 修饰形容词 long，far 加强程度。
词汇点：far too + adj.，如 far too difficult（太难），强调超出合理范围。
explanations.32:
原因：宾语从句引导词，表 “是否”，用于 ask 后。
语法点：if/whether 引导宾语从句，表 “是否” 时可互换，如 “Ask him if/whether he will come.”
